scope: Every tracked regular path, including tests, configurations, binary blobs and LFS pointers as stored. Record all symlinks and exclude them from search.
semantics: A nonempty printable ASCII literal is matched case-sensitively in raw Git blob bytes. Return each matching path once with repository, commit, path, blob ID and its first zero-based byte offset. Line is one plus the number of LF bytes before the offset.
metric: Count of frozen queries whose entire path, blob ID and first byte offset mapping agrees with an independent scan of the pinned Git tree and blobs.

decision.PASS: 8/8, full coverage of 8635 regular paths, at least one nonempty and one empty query, and successful controls.
decision.FAIL: A retrieval discrepancy or another unmet PASS condition on a complete snapshot.
decision.BLOCKED: The pinned snapshot is unavailable or incomplete.

controls: Separate Git fixture with duplicate content at two paths, two matches in one file, binary NUL bytes and a final line without LF.
The verifier must reject a shifted offset and a result missing a genuine matching path.
